answer: Plant lantern traps: the protocol seeds periodic honeypot opportunities — mispriced swaps profitable only to actors executing instant, multi-account, same-window moves. A sybil farm's defining edge is perfect coordination across its shells, so taking the bait reveals the cluster: synchronized uptake marks those accounts as one controller and their future claims are discounted as a group. Honest agents who wander alone into a trap are untouched. Let the ridge of the farm's own synchrony become its cage — coordination turns from weapon into confession.
